activity_statements.statement: manufactures and markets daily-use consumer products across 10 categories organized in 5 operating sectors: Fabric & Home Care (36% of sales), Baby/Feminine/Family Care (24%), Beauty (18%), Health Care (14%) and Grooming (8%)
generates $84.3 billion in annual net sales (FY2025) selling branded consumer products in North America (52%), Europe (22%), Latin America (7%), Greater China (7%), Asia Pacific (7%) and IMEA (5%)

operates global manufacturing, supply chain and distribution infrastructure producing consumer goods across the full product portfolio under brands including Tide, Pampers, Gillette, Oral-B, Crest, Head & Shoulders, Pantene, Olay, Dawn, Febreze, Bounty and Charmin
focuses portfolio on daily-use product categories where performance drives brand choice and maintains superior-quality products at multiple price tiers globally
invests in consumer research, brand marketing and retail partnerships to defend market leadership positions in each of its 10 product categories

name_reality_gap: none — Procter & Gamble and the Manufacturing label are accurate; it is a classic branded consumer goods manufacturer and marketer.
extraction_notes: Excellent financial data from 2025 Annual Report with precise segment revenue shares. Brands list drawn from public knowledge consistent with 10-category framework described in source.
